Tuesday, December 1, 2026, 10:00 PM Local Time

Deoxys (Normal), Deoxys (Defense), Deoxys (Attack), and Deoxys (Speed) will be in five-star raid battles from November 25, 2026 to December 1, 2026.

Raid bosses change at 6:00 a.m. local time.

Raid Hours

There will also be a Raid Hour featuring Deoxys (Normal, Defense, Attack, and Speed Formes) from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time on November 25.
